en: Open your mind, wanderer, and we shall begin.
You have truly excelled in your knowledge of enchanting. There is much more to learn, if you are willing. Speak to Taladan, in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus.
Elune's secrets are many, but they are not to be shared with just anyone.

Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew. The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done. It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining. Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?
I do not see the warrior's spirit within you, child. I have no teachings which would benefit a adventurer such as yourself.
Greetings. Do you seek instruction in art of war?
You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.
Your skill exceeds mine, though I've heard that Old Man Heming in Booty Bay has copies of "The Bass and You". That is sure to help you increase your skill.
I can teach you fishing skills.
Welcome to the Cenarion Circle, adventurer.
I cannot train a adventurer such as yourself.
The esteemed Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen can train you further. He can be found in Theramore treating the wounded at the barracks.
I can train you in First Aid techniques.
I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.
Ah, the beauty of Shadowglen never ceases to delight my senses!
Unfortunately, there is little I can teach someone with your experience, my friend. Seek out the night elf Sylvanna Forestmoon, who resides in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus.
Well done! Your understanding of potions is coming along nicely.
The druids say that it is only a matter of time until nature itself drives the Horde from Kalimdor. Yet corruption continues to spread throughout our lands, even here on Teldrassil.
Well met, friend!
I sure could use a kiss about now. Know where I can find one?
After the firework show, they'll put out goblets so we can raise a toast!
I don't know what they put in those kegs, but it goes down like honey!
Be sure to stick around for the next firework show! Starting at 6PM, they're every hour on the hour!
There are many places that you might visit in Teldrassil. Tell me what you seek.
I cannot train a adventurer such as yourself.
The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.
Elder Bladeswift wanders the paths of Darnassus atop Teldrassil.
Elder Skygleam can be found near the Ravencrest Monument in Azshara.
The stars of this time are bent on new paths, beacons of hope and strength for the coming ages.

Druids are very sensitive to the plight of all creatures of the world. When it was found that these birds were in danger, we set up a system of rescuing them from the corruption of Feralas.

A gnome named Curgle Cranklehop leads the affair; she collects the eggs and has them sent here, where I care for them.

We could always use more help for our cause, adventurer. Maybe you should head over to Gadgetzan and look for Curgle.
Hello, adventurer. I train and care for young hippogryphs here; feel free to have a look around.

Greetings, adventurer. I am the Flamekeeper. During the Midsummer Fire Festival, it is my duty to keep this fire beside me burning brightly. It is an honor to be selected for such a task; I fill it gladly.

 How can I help you?

Enjoying the festival, adventurer?

While the Flamekeeper tends to the fires of the present, I am more of a historian, keeping close the festivals past. I'm also, of course, documenting this year's festivities. Things are going well thus far, don't you think?

You know, adventurer, there is power inherent in all festival fires burning throughout the holiday. We're taking care of ours, but I'm certain there are sacred flames burning deep within our enemy's cities...
Greetings young rogue. What do you seek?
We are but darkness and shadows. Eternal. Invisible.
No, I'm not, but lots of others are looking for love. You should buy my love tokens, put on some cologne or perfume, and then pass them around!
Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

When you give love tokens to townsfolk, you'll receive different gifts in return. Some of those you'll want to keep and use, but others can be bundled together and given to your favorite hero! Visit Kwee Q. Peddlefeet to turn them in.

Kwee can be found near Bolvar, Magni, or Tyrande.

Love tokens are small messages of affection you can give to amorous town and city folk. Such people will reward you with a gift of adoration.

Or, if you are already adored by another, then at the least they'll give you a gift of friendship.

If you put on cologne or perfume, then you'll see who is amorous. Those are the ones who accept love tokens... and offer a gift in return.

But remember: to give someone a love token, you have to smell just right! Men like the scent of perfume, while women prefer cologne.

When you give love tokens to townsfolk, you'll receive different gifts in return. Some of those you'll want to keep and use, but others can be bundled together and given to your favorite hero! Visit Kwee Q. Peddlefeet to turn them in.

Kwee can be found near Cairne, Sylvanas and Thrall.

What can you do at an inn?

Well when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably. Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness. When you are well rested, you learn more from experience.

You may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.

Like a cat dragged in from the rain, you scratch and claw, then do it all over again... I'll be back for more...

Oh, I didn't see you enter, adventurer! What can I do for you?
Our master Malfurion remains lost in the Dreaming, adventurer. His is the light of a beacon that shows the way for us, and we must do everything in our power to preserve that light.

Welcome, my sister. If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Malfurion lies in the Dreaming. Never forget this.

Welcome, my brother. If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Malfurion lies in the Dreaming. Never forget this.
You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?
Ah friend, I only help hunters and their pets.

Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew. The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done. It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining. Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

Even within cold, stone walls such as the ones that shelter this town, one may find tranquility and peace. In fact, you may find them everywhere you are... simply look inside yourself for such balance.

Welcome, my sister. If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you. You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms. It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

Welcome, my brother. If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you. You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms. It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.
You need to make your stitches smaller, Adventurer. Fewer items will slip out of your quivers and ammo pouches. Besides, no one likes a lumpy tunic.
Welcome to our home, Adventurer. Radnaal and I have little to offer, but you are welcome to what hospitality we can provide.
You need to make your stitches smaller, adventurer. Fewer items will slip out of your quivers and ammo pouches. Besides, no one likes a lumpy tunic.
The fish off the coast of Teldrassil are quite large and robust. Rumors say it is the speedy growth of our new world tree that is the cause.
I, Arynia Cloudsbreak, have been tasked with protecting the sanctity of the Oracle Grove.
My wisdom is yours, as is my knowledge. What can I do for you, adventurer?
Elune be with you, adventurer.
This is an exotic sample of flora, unseen in other parts of Teldrassil.
This plant stands out among the normal flora of Teldrassil, and emits a strange, purplish glow.
Like Teldrassil itself, Dolanaar embraces those who embrace the land.
Well met, adventurer. It is good to see that adventurers like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.
Documents such as guild creation papers can be acquired from the Guild Master in the city of Darnassus.
We could certainly use another cook around Dolanaar, not that Zarrin's cooking is lacking mind you. Why don't you go see what he can teach you?
Alanna spends most of her day at the Oracle Glade where she practices her profession. Should you wish to learn the Enchanter's profession you will need to go there to find her.
The druid, Kal, often spends his time at the moonwell in Dolanaar. I am certain he would be able to provide you with the training you require.
The Timberlings have made it too difficult for the fishermen to catch anything around Dolanaar. You best look for someone to train you in Darnassus.
There are many places that you might visit in Teldrassil. Tell me what you seek.
A priestess by the name of Laurna Morninglight calls Dolanaar home. I believe she can be found just north of the Inn.
You can find Radnaal practicing his craft outside his home on the road to Darnassus. You should stop by and see what he can teach you.
Cyndra's knowledge in alchemy is somewhat limited, but I'm sure it would be sufficient to get you started. She practices her craft just east of the Inn in Dolanaar.
Kyra Windblade wields her blade with great skill. She should be able to provide you with some training. You'll find her at the Inn in Dolanaar.
You will find numerous trainers around Dolanaar with ages of experience with which to tutor you. Which would you have me point you to?
Laurna Morninglight offers healing to those that live around Dolanaar. Perhaps she would be able to teach you in the ways of a priest.
Ah, gentle Seriadne. All animals are safe while in her care. You can find her just outside the Inn in Dolanaar.
If a bank is what you desire, then your travels take you to the heart of Darnassus. There you will find storage for your treasures.
Byancie's skill in First Aid has proven useful on numerous occasions. You can find her just north of the Inn in Dolanaar if you wish to learn from her.
Byancie has often lent her services to the sentinels who patrol the local wilds. You should talk to her if you desire to learn First Aid.
Many of the supplies the tailors need come by way of Darnassus. It is not surprising that they all moved there to work. If you wish to be a tailor then you best head to Darnassus.
Nadyia has made quite the leatherworker in her years of practice. Travel west on the road to Darnassus to pay her a visit and maybe she can bestow some of her knowledge upon you.
The bank is located in the serene city of Darnassus. You must go there if you wish to store your possessions.
While Cyndra is not bubbly like her potions, her kind manner is suitable for teaching her trade. You can find her just east of the Inn in Dolanaar.
If a hunter is whom you seek, then it is Dazalar that you should visit. He can usually be found just outside the Inn in Dolanaar.
A Rut'theran Ferry leaves for Auberdine from Rut'theran Village at the base of Teldrassil. The portal in Darnassus will allow you to reach Rut'theran safely.
If you require time to rest and regain your strength, you will find the best at the Inn in Dolanaar. Innkeeper Keldamyr will see to it that you are taken care of.
You seek the aid of a Druid? Then you should go see Kal at the Moonwell just south of the Inn in Dolanaar.
You seek a rogue? I believe Jannok would fit that description. Why don't you go talk to him over at the Inn in Dolanaar.
Herbalism requires a gentle touch that few such as Malorne can teach. Seek him out east of the Inn in Dolanaar.
A rogue? I'm not in the habit of referring people to those types, but I believe Jannok would be the one you're looking for. You will find him at the Inn in Dolanaar.
Zarrin seems to have a good knowledge of the cooking trade. Why don't you go see if he will show you some recipes? He is usually cooking over by the Inn in Dolanaar.
A restful sleep is sure to be had in the beds which Innkeeper Keldamyr keeps at the Inn in Dolanaar.
Alanna Raveneye attributes part of her talent in enchanting to her communion with the spirits at the Oracle Glade. You should be able to find her there now.
Dazalar is well known around Dolanaar for his hunting skill. Why don't you talk to him and see what he can teach you?
You seek the aid of a Adventurer? Then you should go see Kal at the Moonwell just south of the Inn in Dolanaar.
I had the pleasure of seeing Kyra Windblade in combat once. Considering what I witnessed, I am confident she will train you well. Look for her at the Inn in Dolanaar.
Matters of such an official nature are only handled in Darnassus. You must travel there to begin the process of your guild's creation.
The path of those who undertake a profession is long and rewarding. Which path do you choose to walk?
All the fisherman have moved to Darnassus with the recent attacks around Lake Al'Ameth. You should try looking for someone to train you there.
The Maneweavers practice their professions out of their home on the road to Darnassus. Nadyia is an excellent teacher when it comes to Leatherworking. You should see what she can teach you.
To reach the Rut'theran Ferry, you will need to travel to Darnassus and take the portal to Rut'theran Village at the base of Teldrassil.
You seek someone who cares for animals? Then you should look for Seriadne outside the Inn in Dolanaar. She is the one that you seek.
Malorne somehow manages to pick the most delicate herbs without damaging them. Certainly he is the one you should learn from. He lives just east of the Inn in Dolanaar.
I am certain there is a Tailor that could provide you training in Darnassus. When you arrive, ask one of the Sentinels in Darnassus about seeing a Tailor.
To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.
Hello, Adventurer. If you'd like to learn a thing or two about cooking, please visit me at any time.
Hello, adventurer. If you'd like to learn a thing or two about cooking, please visit me at any time.
